entities.summary: Helmut Johannes Baierl was a German writer and vice president of the DDR Academy of Arts, Berlin. He was born in Rumburk (Czechoslovakia) and died in Berlin. He was a member of the NSDAP from 1944 to 1945, of the Liberal Democratic Party of Germany (LDPD) from 1945 to 1947, and of the Socialist Unity Party of Germany (SED) from 1947 to 1989.
